text:
Raj Patel: draft proposal for region routing tie-breakers — need quick consensus.

Ben Liu: +1 to respecting pinned regions for compliance, but for strict latency SLOs we might want to let latency override geo affinity in edge cases :thinking:

Ellie Gomez: agree. also we need a dev override header `X-Region-Pref` (low-priority) and `X-Customer-Region` (account-level, must be honored)

Raj Patel: here's the ordering I'm proposing:
1) `X-Customer-Region` (account pin)
2) `X-Region-Pref` (request-level hint)
3) Region health (exclude unhealthy)
4) Geo-affinity score (locality + routing pref)
5) Latency tiebreaker (real-time RTT)
6) Cost tie-breaker (if scores within epsilon)

Sara Thompson: add zone isolation rule — if region error_rate > 20% or cpu > 80% then failover, but keep data-sovereignty flags honored.

Ben Liu: how do we compute geo-affinity score? propose: score = alpha * estimated_rtt_ms + beta * preference_weight + gamma * recent_error_penalty. we can run this in the routing service and cache scores per region.

Raj Patel: sample config sketch:
```yaml
routes:
  - route: "/v1/generate"
    routing:
      policy: weighted
      weights:
        us-west-2: 0.6
        eu-west-1: 0.3
        ap-southeast-1: 0.1
      tie_breaker_order: [customer_region, header_pref, health, geo_affinity, latency, cost]
      thresholds:
        health_unavailable_pct: 20
        latency_epsilon_ms: 15
``` 

Ellie Gomez: we also need metrics: `routing.chosen_region`, `routing.chosen_reason`, `routing.candidate_scores`, `routing.fallbacks`. cc @Maria Chen for dashboard.

Maria Chen: will add a per-route panel (chosen_region heatmap) + a timeseries for fallback_count and avg chosen_score. also add a trace tag `region_rollout_id` for canaries.

Sara Thompson: sticky KV/cache concern — if we route to different region mid-session we will blow KV caches. propose honoring `X-KV-Cache-Key` and prefer same region when present, unless health forces failover.

Ben Liu: what about emergency manual override from console? Should be able to force-route a customer to a region for debugging. Needs audit log + rate limit.

Raj Patel: yes, console override exists today but it's global. we should scope to account/route and add `override_ttl` and audit. also ensure rollout UI shows % of traffic per region.

deploy-bot: routing-config pushed to staging for tests — deploy #rout-2026-58 :rocket:

Ellie Gomez: test plan: run synthetic p95 latency tests across regions, toggle `X-Region-Pref`, simulate region fail (inject 503s) and verify fallback_count increments + trace tags.

Ben Liu: sounds good. I'll fold this into the PR and include unit for scoring func + telemetry hooks. :+1:

Raj Patel: thanks all — if no objections I'll merge the RFC by EOD and open the console UX card for Maria.
